Shell.brandDescription: Base scaffold for routing, translations, and global UI state in a Next.js admin app.

HomePage.title: Your project is already dressed for launch.
HomePage.description: This onboarding screen is generated to prove the starter is not empty: it carries your brand, your theme, and the first impression your users deserve.

theme.label: Theme
steps: Add the token to :root in globals.css
Give it a value in both light and dark blocks
Read it in components with var(--token)

routes.label: Routes
steps: Drop a page.tsx in src/app — the folder is the path
Add a matching NavLink in app-shell.tsx

store.label: Store
steps: Define an atom beside the store
The provider tree in layout.tsx already holds it
Read and write it with useAtom()

footer.title: Start building
footer.description: Open src/app/page.tsx and replace this screen with your own.

DashboardPage.title: Dashboard workspace
DashboardPage.description: Use this route as the first feature slice for metrics, charts, and operational summaries.

SettingsPage.title: Workspace settings
SettingsPage.description: Language switching and shared workspace preferences already have their wiring in place.

language.title: Translation flow
language.description: The locale switcher updates the react-i18next language and the persisted preference atom.

workspace.title: Shared state
workspace.description: Expand the atom layer with auth, filters, or UI preferences as the admin surface grows.
